title: Relative Bioavailability Study of Nadolol (1 x 80 mg) Tablets Under Fasting Conditions
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to demonstrate the relative bioavailability of Nadolol (1 x 80 mg) tablets under fasting conditions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No clinically significant abnormal finding on physical exam, medical history, or clinical laboratory results on screening.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Positive test results for HIV or hepatitis B or C.
* Treatment for drug or alcohol dependence.
